compression_level.description: Compression level for new gzip files (1 fastest, 9 best compression)

index_span.description: Span in MiB between index points (default 10 MiB)

output_suffix.description: Suffix appended to output files when compressing/decompressing

index_directory.description: Directory or path where index files (.gzi) will be stored (implies -I)

index_line_info.description: How to encode line info in index: 'unix' (default), 'mac' (old Mac CR), 'none'

supervision_enabled.description: If true, enable -S (supervise growing files); implies -i

patching_enabled.description: If true, enable -p (patch corrupted/concatenated gzip streams)

await_time.description: Seconds to wait between reads in supervision/maintenance modes (default 4)

files.description: List of gzip files to index/process on startup
